Highlights of my professional experience

  • 2004-2008

    Graduation - UnB

    I graduated in Advertising in 2008 from the University of Brasília (UnB).

  • 2009-2017

    Up to Strategy Manager at Isobar

    After 8 years I became manager at one of the most brazilian relevant digital agencies

  • 2018

    Data Manager: career change.

    In my first opportunity ahead a data team I had a huge challenge: redesign de Isobar's BI team.

  • 2019-2021

    Data director (TBWA & WPP groups)

    Make this pivotal movement at Isobar's team give me experience and invitation. First to lead Data & Strategies team at the same time as one intelligence team, second, led the Data team of the biggest brazilian ad agency of one of the most worldwide important communications group.

  • 2020-2022

    MBA in Data Science & Analytics - USP

    To prepare myself to my nex movement I need to add a new competence: data science and machine learning. I achived it at University of São Paulo, the most important brazilian college.

  • 2021-2024

    Senior Data Scientist: deep dive

    Time to a new challange: prove my self in a hands on scenario once more, developing ML soluctions and advance analysis in the big data and complex world of fraud prevention to finance service.

Social Listening

Social upheaval on social media: a country in constant crisis

Year: 2017-2019

The period from 2016 to 2019 was very turbulent in the country. If the impeachment of Dilma Roussef and the election of Jair Bolsonaro would be enough to divide and generate a lot of controversy, in the middle of the road there were still many other crises. Pension Reform, Labor Reform, Truckers’ Strike and Brumadinho’s Tragedy are certainly among the main ones. Lots of discussion on the internet, with a lot of discussion on the internet and a lot of international repercussion.
